retailers.meta.description.defaultMessage: Run your counter, put your stock online and see what people nearby look for. Free for now.

retailers.hero.title.description: The {em} placeholder is replaced by the _em key, shown in the brand colour.

retailers.hero.body.defaultMessage: TodayZ gives your shop a point-of-sale, online orders, demand insights and credits that bring customers back. Free for now.

retailers.faq.1.a.defaultMessage: No. TodayZ is free for shops for now.

retailers.faq.2.q.defaultMessage: Can I keep running my shop the way I do now?

retailers.faq.2.a.defaultMessage: Yes. TodayZ adds to how you work today; it does not replace your counter.

retailers.faq.3.q.defaultMessage: Can I see what people near me search for?

retailers.faq.3.a.defaultMessage: Yes. Demand insights show searches near your shop for items you do not stock.
